subject: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and step-up checklist
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lowe <jamie@asterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and step-up checklist

Thanks again for joining the demo earlier — appreciate the open conversation about volume timing and routing profiles. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can put a concrete step-up proposal on paper: 

1) Current baseline & expected ramp
- You mentioned current steady-state of ~80M tokens/month (primarily chat + a small percent of reranking/embeddings).
- Goal is a stepped ramp to ~200M tokens/month within ~6 months with the largest increase on customer support routes (chat).

2) Budget target
- You said procurement is expecting a target unit econ of roughly $1,800–$2,200 per 1M tokens (ballpark). If the range tightens, please flag.

3) Routes and model mix
- We scoped chat (gpt-family open model), embeddings for search/semantic, and a light reranking route. Please confirm expected % split if you have it.

4) Immediate asks from our side
- Can you share the usage export (monthly tokens by route/model) — attached is a template that helps us map to a tiered step-up.
- Procurement timeline: you mentioned early September for vendor decision — confirm target sign date.

Next steps (proposed):
- Jamie: share a 30/60/90 usage snapshot into the attached CSV by EOD Fri 7/30.
- Redwood (Marissa & Ben): we’ll produce a 2-option step-up pricing doc (blended vs. staircase) and a mutually agreed MOP (pilot + commit) by Wed 8/3.

Attachments: usage_export_template.csv

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short MAP and a calendar invite for a scoring call next week.

--
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

From: Jamie Lowe <jamie@asterhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and step-up checklist

Thanks Sofia — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from procurement & engineering: 

- Baseline is confirmed ~80M/mo (70% chat, 20% embeddings, 10% rerank).
- Best-case ramp: 80M -> 140M in 60 days -> 200M by month 6. There is upside but that’s our conservative plan.
- Procurement gave a target of $1,900–$2,100 per 1M tokens for budgeting. They want to see how a blended rate vs. step-staircase compares.
- We need embeddings to be priced predictably if we add a dedicated embeddings route (it’s currently in-proc to move 20% of traffic to embeddings-only nodes).

I attached our preliminary Q3 budget file (Q3_budget_estimate.xlsx) — it has a month-by-month forecast. Procurement is pushing for a vendor decision in the first two weeks of Sept.

Jamie

Attachments: Q3_budget_estimate.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: target $/1M tokens and step-up checklist

Quick internal note — draft pricing approach to feed into the 8/3 deliverable: 

Option A (Blended step-up):
- 0–100M: $2,200 / 1M tokens (covers chat + base infrastructure)
- 100–250M: $1,650 / 1M tokens
- Blended effective (for 200M): ~ $1,900 / 1M tokens

Option B (Staircase + Route add-on):
- Chat route (primary): $2,300 / 1M for first 100M, $1,700 thereafter
- Embeddings route (dedicated): $0.45 per 1k embedding units (flat) with a committed capacity discount at >50M embeddings/month
- 12-month committed term => additional 10% off blended price; Dedicated capacity commitment => faster SLAs and lower p95 latency SLOs (sell this if latency is a blocker)

Risks/notes:
- If Aster wants strict procurement floor for unit cost, we can lean into Option A with a guarantee on blended price at milestone check-ins.
- Need the actual route % split from the CSV to compute exact blended.

I’ll draft the two-page comparison PDF and a short MAP for Sofia to send.

Marissa

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Lowe <jamie@asterhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, AsterHealth Procurement <procurement@asterhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP + next steps: pilot kickoff window and pricing options

Jamie — thanks for the quick turnaround on the forecast. Attaching the two-option brief (redwood-stepup-mop.pdf) and a short MAP below so procurement has the timeline.

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- By 8/5: Aster — return completed usage_export_template.csv (monthly rows, route columns).
- By 8/10: Redwood — deliver Option A (blended) and Option B (staircase + embeddings addon) with explicit blended math and a sample invoice.
- By 8/17: Pilot start (30–60 day pilot on hosted Richmond region) — pilot metrics: p95 latency, token consumption by route, and quality checks.
- By 9/09: Procurement decision target (vendor selection + SOW execution).

Commercial notes:
- Based on your forecast, blended pricing should fall in the $1,850–$1,950 / 1M tokens band for the first 6 months under our Option A with a 12-month commit discount applied. Exact number depends on route split.
- We will include a clause to re-run blended math at 3 months to ensure unit econ targets are met; any large divergence triggers an agreed remediation (rebate or rate adjustment).

Links & next steps:
- I’ve sent a 30-minute slot for the scoring call: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=sofia-demo-0803
- DocuSign preview for outline commercial term (not final): https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/ABC1234

Attachments: redwood-stepup-mop.pdf, usage_export_template.csv

If procurement wants, we can set a short technical review with our infra lead (Ben) to validate latency and embeddings throughput on dedicated nodes.

Thanks — looking forward to the completed CSV.

--
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
